descriptions: Productionized a Text-to-SQL agent using LangGraph, FastAPI, LangFuse and Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B to query PostgreSQL databases, reducing data retrieval time from 12 hours to under 10 seconds with 95% accuracy.
Slashed smart contract audit time from 2 days to just 15 mins by building a proprietary audit framework with LangGraph, saving over 95% in labor costs while maintaining 93.66% accuracy.

Post-trained Qwen2.5-series models via SFT and Agentic-RL (GRPO, PPO) using PyTorch, verl, and DeepSpeed across an multi-GPU cluster, improving trading platform interaction by 25% and reducing inference costs.

Enabled quantitative investment strategies by a distributed NLP extraction pipeline using Ray and YOLOv8 to parse 100,000+ unstructured financial reports, utilizing Llama 3.1 to structure revenue tables with 83% accuracy.
Constructed a financial knowledge graph from unstructured text using NetworkX, applying PageRank and Louvain algorithms to accelerate quantitative research signal generation by 52%.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to design and implement data extraction workflows to streamline business operations.
Built a full-stack GenAI application using React.js, Flask, and the OpenAI API to automate funding proposal creation, reducing generation time by 65%.
Implemented a Zero-Shot QA entity extraction pipeline for lending reports using Hugging Face Transformers, achieving 94% accuracy to accelerate downstream quantitative analysis.
Architected, maintained, and supported complex system and network infrastructures.
Administered operating systems, managed server configurations, and oversaw Oracle database server operations.
